title: Why only 100 characters?
summary: The context window, and why it is a hard limit.

steps.text: The position table has exactly 100 rows, so the model can only ever see 100 positions. Longer text is cut to its last 100 characters: the window **slides**.
steps.prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her dog Max. One day, they went to the park and saw a big tree.

steps.text: Under the prompt box: the characters that slid out of view are no longer anywhere in the network. Whatever they said is forgotten unless it was repeated later.

Generation repeats this for every new character: run the whole window, read the last row, sample, append, slide. The attention matrix is T×T, so cost grows with the square of the window: one reason context is limited.
